natalie (People Ops): Quick note for teams that work with contractors/vendors: there's a short guidance update on how contractor contribution should be handled in this cycle. TL;DR: contractors do not receive formal "ratings" but their feedback can be captured for manager context.
omar (Eng Manager): Thanks. So for contractor conversions mid-cycle, do we treat them as new hires or eligible for level adjustments?
natalie (People Ops): Conversions: if the conversion date is before the manager signoff window starts, treat them as internal hires for that cycle (full packet). If conversion happens after freeze, they default to next cycle. DM people-ops with conversion paperwork so we can tag them in the tracker.
tess (Contractor): For contractors who drove major feature work, can managers request recognition (bonus/spot award)?
boa (Finance): Yes managers can request spot awards. Submit via the rewards form (https://intra/redwood/rewards/request). Please include contractor legal name and invoice # so Finance can route payment.
ralph (Vendor Lead): Our vendors are sensitive about sharing internal notes. How do we provide evidence without exposing vendor IP?
natalie (People Ops): Prefer a sanitized summary (2 bullets) plus a link to a redacted deliverable in the shared folder with viewer access. If redaction is heavy, mark it in the packet as "vendor evidence (redacted)" and People Ops will record a note for calibration.
omar (Eng Manager): Do vendor contributors get mentioned in calibration panels? I don't want to crowd the panel.
natalie (People Ops): Mention them as contributors in the manager packet. No voting or rating for vendors. If impact is material and you seek product recognition, flag for Org Awards.
pm-bot: Reminder: vendor-contributor column added to tracker. Update by 2024-05-05 17:00 PT.
tess (Contractor): If a contractor has been on a 12-month engagement and we plan to convert, but legal paperwork is pending, can we include a "conversion ask" in the packet?
natalie (People Ops): Yes include the ask with the caveat "pending legal HIRE-APPROVAL". We'll treat it as advisory in calibration and finalize only once HR sign-off occurs.
ralph (Vendor Lead): For fractional contributors (e.g., 20% time), should their impact be normalized?
omar (Eng Manager): Good Q. We often forget to scale.
natalie (People Ops): Normalize contributions in the evidence: include FTE fraction & dates. Example: "Contributed 0.25 FTE from 2024-01-10 to 2024-04-10; outcome: reduced latency by 18%". Calibration chairs appreciate the context.
pm-bot: Action: export s3://people-ops/exports/contractor_flagged_2024.csv
boa (Finance): Also note: contractors with spot award requests must have invoices <60 days old. Finance will reject late claims.
tess (Contractor): Will feedback we provide be shared with us? Contractors sometimes ask for context for future gigs.
natalie (People Ops): We do not provide formal manager rating feedback to contractors. Managers may choose to share a manager note summary at their discretion, but keep any proprietary internal reasoning internal.
omar (Eng Manager): What about mentors who are contractors and then convert? Conflict of interest if the mentor becomes the manager?
natalie (People Ops): Conflict rules apply: any prior managerial/mentorship relationship within 18 months should be flagged. If conversion creates a conflict, People Ops will assign an alternate reviewer. Include a short COI note in the packet.
ralph (Vendor Lead): Is there a separate privacy path for vendor-supplied customer data in evidence? Our contracts require redaction.
natalie (People Ops): For customer data, use the legal redaction checklist and loop Legal. We added a "redaction required" tag in the packet template; Legal will confirm compliance before calibration.
pm-bot: Reminder: manager checklist updated with contractor guidance.
boa (Finance): One last finance note: converted hires that affect comp bands will be handled in the post-calibration comp pass; Finance will request salary start dates.
tess (Contractor): Thanks! Appreciate the clarity — will ask my manager to add the sanitized evidence.
omar (Eng Manager): Great, I'll update the tracker with two vendor contributors and a pending conversion.
natalie (People Ops): Thanks all 44d We'll consolidate a 1-page "contractor & vendor guidance" PDF and post to the checklist page by EOD.
